title: Plateau progress view — schema 2 with schema 1 compatibility
description: Declarative slice-1 wire contract. Definitions and examples are independently consumable; no collector or UI is required. Cross-field arithmetic, source-key joins and temporal comparisons remain consumer conformance responsibilities.

freshness.description: Source observation time is independent of publisher heartbeat. Preserve last good timestamps on failure; null is unknown, never observed zero.

measure.description: source names an entry in sources. Null means unknown; a partial numeric tally counts only observed work. Units must not be summed.

collection.description: Metadata for the corresponding row array; included is its length, total is unknown when the full population is unknown. Slice 1 does not silently truncate or advertise paging.

author.description: Distinct author attribution; missing or null means unknown.

origin.description: Distinct origin attribution; missing or null means unknown.

run.description: Stable producer-qualified runId, repo-qualified card/PR refs. Preserve unknown role/state codes. Owner, author, origin, supervisor, executor and requested/reported models remain distinct; never infer one from another. Idle, dead and waiting jobs are not moving. Missing or null extensions mean unknown; included evidence objects require complete shape. Source-key joins, provenance truth, time ordering, freshness assessment, count arithmetic and identity deduplication are consumer responsibilities, not proven by shape validation.

action.description: Only explicit human review or a ready decision fork in slice 1. Pending review, failed CI and absent handlers alone never create an action. A not-ready human review remains pending while the system prepares it.

schema2.description: Slice-1 overview contract. PublisherId identifies a boot; sequence increases within it. Deploy schema-1+2 readers before publishing 2. Retain unknown raw codes. Product owns aggregation, freshness assessment, ordering, action classification, payload bounds and relay enforcement. Future sections may be added without changing this major.

healthInstant.description: Calendar-valid UTC ISO instant; source evidence time, never publisher refresh time.

healthFreshness.description: Source observation time is independent of publisher heartbeat. Preserve last good timestamps on failure; null is unknown, never observed zero.

healthRemediation.description: Last persisted remediation attempt and result; no refresh action is implied.

healthEscalation.description: Only explicit humanOnly true may project to Needs you. actionRef links the existing action for deduplication.

healthEpisode.description: Stable episode identity; unknown severity codes stay visible in rawSeverity. Missing remediation is unknown, not success.

healthPause.description: Explicit intentional pause evidence, distinct from stalled work.

healthDaemon.description: Completion and heartbeat are separate evidence. Assess stalls only against evidenced cadence; null cadence is never inferred.

healthBudgetCoverage.description: Request attribution coverage; null is unmeasured, not zero. Preserve torn/truncated source coverage in reason.

healthBudgetWindow.description: Keep identity/resource/reset windows separate. Counts are response headroom observations, not live balances; an expired reset stays stale until a new response. Never infer identity from caller labels.

healthOvernight.description: Read-only evidence, not a control API. Preserve raw mode/state codes. Null job scope/next check must not be invented. Requested stop with running jobs remains pending or conflicting; policy alone cannot prove stopped.

healthEpisodes.description: Null rows mean unavailable, never an empty healthy collection; freshness explains missing or partial evidence.

healthDaemons.description: Null rows mean unavailable, never an empty healthy collection; freshness explains missing or partial evidence.

healthBudgetWindows.description: Null rows mean unavailable, never an empty healthy collection; freshness explains missing or partial evidence.

health.description: Optional schema-2 health evidence. Omission in older snapshots means unavailable. Each source retains its own observation/success times, cadence, completeness and reason. All supplied fields are validated; unknown values are explicit nulls with explanatory status/reason. Temporal comparisons, reference joins and arithmetic remain consumer responsibilities.

progressSourceEvidence.description: Source identity and source-local observation time, distinct from since/asOf and publisher refresh.

progressActorEvidence.description: Attested actor identity and provider; unknown identity stays null even with known source. Never infer executor from owner, launcher or supervisor.

progressRequestedModelEvidence.description: requested model evidence with its own source. Requested configuration never attests served model. Unknown provider codes and model mismatches are valid.

progressReportedModelEvidence.description: reported model evidence with its own source. Requested configuration never attests served model. Unknown provider codes and model mismatches are valid.

progressFileReference.description: Repo-qualified relative file reference, without absolute paths or traversal. Producers must exclude prompts, credentials and machine-local log paths.

progressOverlapEvidence.description: Observed counterpart and files; null means unknown; empty files means observed empty. Never fabricate a match.

progressCapacityEvidence.description: Zero is measured zero; null is unknown. Used may exceed limit; observations impose no dispatch policy.

prWaitingChain.description: Observed queue and conditional next-step order, not a scheduler. Observation time is not wait-start or claim-start. Active holders require unexpired leases; ETA is producer evidence, never computed here.

prRow.description: Author-independent rows, including cardless PRs. Identity is repo plus number. Full synthetic descriptions illustrate content; schema cannot prove arbitrary free text has no secrets. Producers redact. Preserve old-head evidence but never use it or missing CI to certify current readiness. primaryWait is display policy, never merge authorization. Fixture conformance checks identity, source joins, head matching and temporal relationships.

prCollection.description: Separate paged semantics: total is the universe (null means unknown), cached is fixed snapshot membership, included is rows in this payload; complete describes universe coverage, not page exhaustion. Consumer conformance requires included <= cached <= known total, complete only for a known fully cached universe with complete source evidence. Legacy collection semantics are unchanged.

prPageRequest.description: Standalone cached-page message, not a root snapshot. Null request cursor starts traversal. Echo collection, identity and cursor exactly; opaque cursors bind to one snapshot and publisher boot. Restart never mixes replacement rows into the old snapshot. Fixture checks enforce fixed membership, counts, cursor continuity and exhaustion; this harness is not a shipped product validator.
